cover.concept: A single flat lantern silhouette in accent orange glows inside a small storefront window shape rendered in muted indigo, its light gathered and redirected outward through a simple megaphone-horn silhouette resting on the window ledge, projecting one long narrow accent-orange beam far across an otherwise empty, unlit street below.

inline.name: creator-discovery-filter
inline.concept: A flat magnifying glass silhouette in muted indigo hovers over a dense grid of identical flat grey silhouetted figures; only two or three figures are rendered in accent orange because they already hold a small matching object, while every other figure in the grid stays flat and unlit.

inline.name: time-boxed-permission
inline.concept: Two flat hands meeting in a simple handshake silhouette, rendered in muted indigo, sealed at the wrist by a small accent-orange hourglass shape in place of a knot or a lock, with fine sand visibly settled in the hourglass's lower bulb against a plain neutral background.
